_readme: Joshua's collages. One entry per piece, in display order. image = full size, thumb = small. medium is shown under the title. Used by index.html (Art in In the Works) and shop.html (Art). To add one: put <slug>.jpg and <slug>-sm.jpg in photos/art/ and add an entry here.

pieces.title: Just Curious
pieces.blurb: The question that runs everything, pinned to the top. A Quincy Jones symphony ticket, a new pope pleading for peace, Ovechkin passing Gretzky, and a typewriter clacking toward the future.

pieces.title: God's Message to You
pieces.blurb: A pocket gospel tract, an ad promising “Anytime. Everywhere. Free.” and headlines taking it all back: jobs gone, prices still high, an EV that doesn’t know what it should sound like.

pieces.title: Questions Persist
pieces.blurb: “Mr. President, what did you get reelected to do?” opens a black board of tariffs, betting scandals, a new pope and my own student ID. Ohtani knew; the bookie never asked.

pieces.title: City of Dreams
pieces.blurb: Los Angeles during the ICE protests: flags, riot lines, Chinga La Migra and a small American flag in the corner. Uncomfortable history, kept as it happened.

pieces.title: The Adventure Above All
pieces.blurb: Affordability, rediscovered. Shutdown math, 50-year mortgages, the Epstein files and Mamdani’s win, held together by a Basquiat phone case and an AI Slop sticker.

pieces.title: Halfway to History
pieces.blurb: The framed one. Nines everywhere, an election fright, a rare comet and a new cold war, and one word at the bottom that says what I do: strategist.
